visual.description: Duel-mode comparison: Merino Wool vs Polyester. Left: Merino — '30% weight in moisture' stat, 'Eczema reduction (12-week trial)' in Positive Green, '17.5μm fiber' spec. Right: Polyester — 'Traps sweat against skin', 'Occlusive microenvironment' in Negative Red, 'Bacterial growth 1.72×10⁷'. Below: Linen/Hemp callout card — 'Naturally antimicrobial, no chemical treatment needed' in Accent Blue. Flat surface for readability.
visual.sourceText: Source: Hon et al., Am. J. Clin. Dermatol., 2020
